items.title: Scarecrow Holding a Blank Banner
items.alt: Two differently dressed small scarecrows hold opposite corners of a blank cream banner, one in a burgundy tunic and sage cap and the other in a lavender blouse and ochre headwrap.
items.description: Two differently dressed small scarecrows hold opposite corners of a blank cream banner, one in a burgundy tunic and sage cap and the other in a lavender blouse and ochre headwrap. An original scarecrow illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.

items.title: Scarecrow in a Hayride Wagon
items.alt: A softly smiling scarecrow in a charcoal hat and dusty rose sweater sits beside a pumpkin on hay inside a small four-wheel wooden wagon.
items.description: A softly smiling scarecrow in a charcoal hat and dusty rose sweater sits beside a pumpkin on hay inside a small four-wheel wooden wagon. An original scarecrow illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.

items.title: Scarecrow beside Stacked Pumpkins
items.alt: A narrow sack-faced scarecrow in a dark red hat and black cardigan steadies three differently sized orange pumpkins in a vertical stack.
items.description: A narrow sack-faced scarecrow in a dark red hat and black cardigan steadies three differently sized orange pumpkins in a vertical stack. An original scarecrow illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.

items.title: Scarecrow at a Cider Stand
items.alt: A small smiling scarecrow in a blue cloth cap and yellow apron fills a plain cup from an amber drink dispenser at a wooden stall with a blank overhead board.

items.title: Scarecrow Opening a Garden Gate
items.alt: A hessian-faced scarecrow in a brown cowboy hat and mauve duster holds open a short hinged garden gate beside a pumpkin vine.

items.title: Scarecrow Repairing a Paper Lantern
items.alt: A white-faced scarecrow in a pale blue hood and salmon knitted vest ties a handle onto an unlit paper lantern with twine.
